comment: The billing glossary, for code that cannot import kit/src/billing-words.ts: the desktop app (desktop-gpui/src/pages/billing.rs) and the Rust CLI (rs/crates/nexus-cli). kit/src/billing-words.test.ts checks this file against the TypeScript, and each Rust test checks its own strings against it. afterTheFact holds one example per charge phase (kit/src/after-the-fact.ts): afterTheFactBase with the example's patch, the phase, and the notice a surface shows. receiptsEmpty holds what an empty Receipts list says: afterTheFactBase with each example's patch (null: no afterTheFact), and its text (null: plain).
